Competitions

One yearly competition.

Smaller mentor-led events sit beside it.

Get updatesSee the North America plan

The 2027 footprint is North America and Africa. AfroBot is hosting an event in Africa. The 2027 season in Dallas–Fort Worth scales the 2024 pilot to about 15 teams and about 90 students.

Students will show what they built, whom it helps, and what changed after testing.

Separate dates

North America and Africa meet on separate dates and share a two-way livestream.

AfroBot teams build AI and robotics solutions, then present that work at a regional showcase and a national showcase. The season is complementary to other youth robotics programs.
